caption:
"Write a letter to your younger self" sounds healing. But for an overthinker's brain, it becomes a list of every mistake. The Tomorrow Letter flips the direction — you write to who you'll be in the morning. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this.

#journaling #overthinking #selfcompassion #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: write a letter to your younger self — you wrote every mistake you ever made
